import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for safe substitution. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}
{event_title}
Date: {event_date}
{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def create_event_invitation(title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- title : str Title or name of the event. description : str Comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple paragraphs). date : str Scheduled date of the event. notes : str Supplementary information or instructions provided by the organizer. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string ready for safe display. """ # Escape all user-provided content to neutralize potential XSS payloads safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Format the invitation using the predefined template return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes )
